prompt: A refresh-token request returns a generic server error when the token is expired. Fix the behavior so expired refresh tokens map to the documented auth error response without changing public API names.

Cancelling an order should release any inventory reservations associated with that order before publishing the cancellation event. Fix the behavior without changing the public cancel_order signature or existing order status result.

The retry configuration from configs/retry_policy.toml is ignored by the billing retry path. Make load_invoice_retry_policy use the invoice_retry TOML section while preserving defaults of 30 seconds, 5 attempts, and multiplier 2 when the file or values are absent.

Payment webhook signature failures are being treated as generic failures and still trigger downstream state changes. Reject invalid signatures with the documented auth response before mutating invoice state or publishing events.

InvoiceRepository.mark_retry_requested currently leaks a downstream TimeoutError and can leave the database transaction dirty. Convert a timeout into False, roll back when the session supports rollback, and return True after a successful update without changing the method name.

Add InventoryService.is_reservation_active(reservation_id) as a small public helper. It must use the reservation store's find_by_id method, return False for missing or released reservations, and keep persistence details private.

Allow NotificationDispatcher to read notifications.email_dispatch_enabled from configs/feature_flags.yaml in the current project. Dispatch must be suppressed only when the flag is explicitly false and must preserve current behavior when the file, section, or flag is missing.

For a verified JSON webhook whose type is billing.invoice.paid, BillingWebhookController must publish an invoice-paid EventEnvelope containing invoice_id, customer_email, and amount. Add the corresponding event constant and teach the existing NotificationDispatcher to send the invoice_paid template to that customer. Preserve existing signature verification and webhook behavior.

Extract the duplicated decode_refresh_payload call in AuthService.refresh_session and revoke_session into one private _decode_refresh helper. Both public methods must call the helper, and all existing behavior and public names must remain unchanged.

Refactor PaymentGateway retry handling behind a RetryExecutor Protocol. PaymentGateway must accept an injected executor and retry policy provider, use the selected InvoiceRetryPolicy for attempts, and preserve verify_signature and charge public behavior.

Rename the internal order_cancelled_event helper to build_order_cancelled_event and update every downstream reference. Preserve EventEnvelope serialization, OrderService.cancel_order behavior, and all public method signatures.
